chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Barqī, from Saʿd ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, from al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the skins of al-sammūr. He said, “What kind of thing is that? Is it the dark-colored one?” I said, “It is the black one.” He said, “Does it hunt?” I said, “Yes, it takes chickens and pigeons.” He said, “No.”

key_terms.السَّمُّورِ: al-sammūr, a fur-bearing animal under discussion in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray in the skin of al-sammūr according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal inquiry to al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the skin of al-sammūr in the context of prayer. The Imam عليه السلام asks whether the animal is predatory, and when told that it hunts birds, he replies negatively, indicating disapproval of using it in this legal context.
